# S55 — Matrix conversation adapter

A Matrix bot account that receives commands and sends replies and notifications.

**Findings:** C3 · **Size:** M · **Tree:** core

**Not in this slice:** end-to-end encrypted rooms, unless the interview requires them.

## Why

Chat suits quick back-and-forth better than email, and Matrix is FLOSS and self-hostable.
